default.notes: Visitor (V) visa required, applied for online via the Cancillería portal before travelling.

groups.notes: 90 days visa-free under the Mercosur/CAN arrangements — nationals can enter with their national ID card (no passport needed). Extendable to a maximum of 180 days per calendar year; submit the free Check-Mig form before your flight.

90 days visa-free on arrival (Permiso de Ingreso y Permanencia), extendable once for 90 more at Migración Colombia — maximum 180 days per calendar year. Submit the free Check-Mig form before your flight.

CO.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Colombian citizens.

CN.notes: Chinese passport holders generally need a Visitor (V) visa, but may enter visa-free if they hold a valid US or Schengen visa or residence permit. Colombia announced a broader visa waiver for Chinese tourists in 2025 — confirm the current rule with a Colombian consulate before booking.
